purpose: Full T01–T12 and V01–V18 acceptance ledger. An attached command/media report proves only its named facts; it does not automatically approve visual quality or complete a task.

requirements.name: 资产模型与版本
requirements.acceptance: Safe draft editing, immutable versions, optimistic revision checks, per-style readiness, media/review hash invalidation and v1 compatibility.

requirements.name: 动作准备任务
requirements.acceptance: Pack-owned generation tasks, camera/role-scoped retry, persisted external task IDs, restart recovery and completed-artifact retention.

requirements.name: 自动检查与问题定位
requirements.acceptance: Reject stills, lip-only, LED-only and camera-only false motion; report visibility/identity uncertainty and temporal issues without pretending automatic human approval.

requirements.name: 资产准备与审看界面
requirements.acceptance: List readiness by style, create candidates, compare original/processed clips, edit continuous usable ranges, accept immutable versions and expose failure intervals.

requirements.name: 预览与生成界面
requirements.acceptance: Bind ready pack versions, show missing cameras and actual native/export specs, invalidate stale preview acceptance and retain adopted outputs.

requirements.name: 快速多机位渲染
requirements.acceptance: Real two-shot and reverse-camera assets, correct visible-speaker drive, sample-clock edits, same preview/final plan and no crop masquerading as reverse shot.

requirements.name: 多动作调度与接缝
requirements.acceptance: Multiple speaking/listening/reaction candidates, deterministic plans, pose/velocity joins, avoid adjacent repeated obvious reactions and validate 30-second naturalness.

requirements.name: 缓存与失效规则
requirements.acceptance: Reuse unchanged voice/action/features/camera outputs with content/version-based keys; follow the edit matrix and report actual model calls and hits.

requirements.name: 分段复用与重规划
requirements.acceptance: Reuse eligible intervals, regenerate changed context, replan duration-shifted boundaries and retain necessary pose dependencies without claiming all edits affect only one sentence.

requirements.name: 运行时性能
requirements.acceptance: Reproducible environment and GPU switching, explicit cold/warm paired runs, memory/call counters and measured benefit without quality regression.

requirements.name: 诊断与统计
requirements.acceptance: Correct ownership/stages/retries, timings/cache/call metrics and evidence provenance; distinguish connectivity, model execution and perceptual acceptance.

requirements.name: 兼容与分批发布
requirements.acceptance: Reviewed batches pushed remotely, old projects/templates retain bindings, no active-runtime overwrite and demonstrated feature rollback with adopted media retained.

requirements.name: 重复静帧
requirements.acceptance: Repeated stills cannot become approved motion templates.

requirements.name: 仅嘴部或灯光变化
requirements.acceptance: Lip-only or LED-only change is not accepted as structural body motion.

requirements.name: 背景或镜头移动
requirements.acceptance: Camera/background motion cannot establish object motion.

requirements.name: 脸可检测但遮眼
requirements.acceptance: Detected face with lampshade eye occlusion is flagged and cannot be automatically adopted.

requirements.name: 侧转丢失五官
requirements.acceptance: Side-turn intervals with unavailable facial features are rejected or excluded with recorded provenance.

requirements.name: 背景误检
requirements.acceptance: False faces on lamps/plants/hardware never change the subject binding.

requirements.name: 额外前景人脸
requirements.acceptance: A real extra foreground face is flagged and not driven accidentally.

requirements.name: 修改一句对白
requirements.acceptance: Unchanged voice and motion are reused; evidence records the necessary rerender scope and actual calls.

requirements.name: 修改对白时长
requirements.acceptance: Affected shot joins are replanned and the final sample clock has no accumulated drift.

requirements.name: 缺少反打机位
requirements.acceptance: Both UI and API reject the incomplete style while retaining ready alternatives.

requirements.name: 重复提交
requirements.acceptance: Repeated same-token submissions create only one inference task.

requirements.name: 生成中重启
requirements.acceptance: Restore reconnects the original engine task and does not repeat sampling.

requirements.name: 已采用媒体篡改
requirements.acceptance: Changed media hashes block new generation; adopted historical videos remain available.

requirements.name: 历史工程兼容
requirements.acceptance: Existing projects and templates retain original mode, version and behavior.

requirements.name: 不同镜头风格配音一致
requirements.acceptance: Two-shot and reverse-shot output using the same adopted timeline have exactly equal decoded PCM audio.

requirements.name: 改变导出规格
requirements.acceptance: Changing export size/encoding does not call the motion generator.

requirements.name: 生成失败或取消
requirements.acceptance: Original output and completed source assets survive failure/cancellation.

requirements.name: 模拟提供方隔离
requirements.acceptance: Simulated output cannot count as real media or model acceptance.
